The homeowner had paid in full on completion day, and the fix cost more than the original job. Here's the prep step nobody quoted and the payment structure that would have kept leverage alive.

title: The Final Invoice Came in $8K Over the Contract. Escrow Meant It Didn't Get Paid.

title: The Notice Clause That Forces Complaints in Writing Before They Become Disputes

title: The Client Wants the Lien Release Signed Before They Pay: Why That's Backwards

title: The Plumbing Rough-In Leaked Behind the Wall. Escrow Meant the Homeowner Held Firm.
